title: Infinitesimal etaleness implies etaleness with proper source over a complete base
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring complete for an ideal $I$ [def-weil-pbc-adically-complete-ring]. Let $f:Y\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum] be a scheme morphism with $Y$ locally Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth], and $g:X\to Y$ of finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism], such that $g$ followed by $f$ is proper [def-weil-proper-morphism]. For each $n\ge0$, put $Y_n=Y\times_{\operatorname{Spec}A}\operatorname{Spec}(A/I^{n+1})$ [def-pc-base-change, def-pc-fibre-product]. If the morphism $X\times_Y Y_n\to Y_n$ is etale [def-weil-etale-morphism] for every n, then g is etale. No properness of f or Noetherianity of A is required.

source.place: Fundamental Groups, Lemma 0GS2, essential-surjectivity proof, complete Noetherian case

proof.text: Apply etale_open_of_infinitesimal_restrictions to h_etale, obtaining W, containment of the closed fiber preimage, and Etale(W.ι ≫ g).

Apply proper_closed_fiber_open_eq_top to I, f, g, W and the containment. Substitute W = top. Compose the etale restriction with the inverse of Scheme.topIso; Scheme.toIso_inv_ι and associativity identify this composite with g.

from.place: Complete Noetherian essential-surjectivity argument in step 7 of the ancestor split: etaleness of the algebraized map from its infinitesimal restrictions and specialization into the closed fibre

lean.statement:
theorem etale_of_infinitesimal_restrictions_of_proper
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A) [IsAdicComplete I A]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ Spec (.of A)) (g : X ⟶ Y)
    [IsLocallyNoetherian Y] [LocallyOfFiniteType g] [QuasiCompact g]
    [IsProper (g ≫ f)]
    (h_etale : ∀ n : ℕ, Etale (pullback.snd g (pullback.fst f
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1)))))))) :
    Etale g
